explication: Fabric is an AI-augmentation framework centered on reusable task patterns. Users submit prompts or media through the CLI or Svelte web UI; the server routes requests into chat orchestration, pattern/extension processing, and configurable AI-provider plugins, returning streamed or structured results. Sessions, contexts, patterns, and notes persist through filesystem-backed storage. The tree and excerpts establish web-to-REST forwarding, storage delegation, extension execution, YouTube transcript retrieval, and file-change parsing; several deeper server orchestration calls are represented conservatively from their module boundaries.
